name: DatasetVersion
fields: id, project_id, checksum, schema, uri, created_at

name: DataProfile
fields: dataset_version_id, columns, statistics, alerts, computed_by (version du moteur)

name: SplitSpec
fields: strategy (random, stratified, group, time), test_ratio, cv_folds (≥ 1), val_ratio (si cv_folds = 1), seed, target, group_column, time_column

name: SplitVersion
fields: id, dataset_version_id, split_spec, checksum, effectifs, distribution_cible, uri_indices (accès au test réservé à l'évaluation finale)

name: PreprocessStep
fields: type, columns, params

name: PreprocessSpec
fields: id, version, dataset_version_id, steps, content_hash (aucun artefact ajusté)

name: ErrorModel
fields: code, message, details, request_id

name: ValidationReport
fields: subject{kind, id, version}, content_hash, status (ok, warning, error), layers[{layer, status, issues[{code, severity, node_id, path, message, hint}]}], catalog_version

name: AuditEvent
fields: id, project_id, actor{type, id}, ts, action (AuditAction), resource_ref, outcome, reason, approval_id, request_id

name: ExecutionRef
fields: execution_id, node_id, attempt

name: ModelSpec
fields: id, version, family, task, modality, params_schema, dependencies, determinism (exact ou tolérance)

name: TrainingConfig
fields: split_id, preprocess_spec_id, model_id, params, primary_metric, direction, seed

name: TrainingJob
fields: id, execution_ref, status (JobStatus), progress, error_code, run_id

name: ExperimentRun
fields: id, config_hash, protocol_hash, metrics (validation croisée), test_metrics (si test_evaluated), artifacts, environment, mlflow_run_id, test_evaluated

name: ModelArtifact
fields: id, run_id, format (mlflow-pyfunc), contenu (modèle + préprocesseur ajusté), input_schema (colonnes brutes), signature, environment (requirements verrouillés), checksum

name: Leaderboard
fields: protocol_hash, primary_metric, direction, entrées[{run_id, métriques, rang}]

name: ModelVersion
fields: id, name, version, run_id, alias, artifact_ref, created_at

name: GoalSpec
fields: task, target, objective{primary_metric, direction}, constraints, ambiguities

name: PlanProposal
fields: id, goal_id, workflow_version_id, rationale par nœud, assumptions, warnings, evidence_refs, required_approvals, validation_report_ref

name: Explanation
fields: subject_ref, texte, evidence_refs (obligatoires pour tout chiffre)

name: ToolInvocation
fields: name, typed_args, operation_class, authorization, result_ref

name: EvidenceRef
fields: source_type, source_id, summary

name: ConversationState
fields: project_id, turns, context_refs, mode

name: DecisionAudit
fields: vue filtrée des AuditEvent de l'assistant : propositions, appels d'outils, refus, preuves

name: NodeType
fields: type, version, owner, input_ports, output_ports, params_schema, adapter, export_template

name: WorkflowSpec
fields: schema_version, catalog_version, nodes[{id, type, type_version, params, ui}], edges[{id, from{node, port}, to{node, port}}], metadata{task, target, objective, origin, goal_id}

name: WorkflowVersion
fields: id, workflow_id, parent_version_id, content_hash (hors ui), author{type, id}, created_at, spec (immuable)

name: Approval
fields: id, project_id, user_id, workflow_version_id, content_hash, scope (version ou lignée), operation_classes, budget, mode, method (explicit_click ou chat_confirm), expires_at, status

name: Execution
fields: id, workflow_version_id, approval_ids, status (ExecutionStatus), reuse_from, node_runs[{node_id, attempt, status, cached, job_ref, error, result_refs}]

name: ExportManifest
fields: export_id, workflow_version_id, content_hash, execution_id, dataset_refs, split_refs, preprocess_spec, model_configs, seeds, environment (lockfile), code[{path, sha256, template_id}], artifacts[{ref, checksum, included}], limitations, integrity

name: PromotionRecord
fields: id, model_version_id, alias, approval_id, actor, checks (test_evaluated, reproductibilité), created_at
